realized_metrics.window_convention: No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth; this object records full-period baseline metrics from DEC-0005 and TEST-08.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0002 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0002 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0002 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0002 records cost_drag_fraction above that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0002 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.
